You Need a Playbook Built for $500+ Reality. When you log into our Small Accounts Room, you immediately know you finally found what you have been searching for: not a reckless internet marketer telling you to gamble your last $500 on lottery-ticket options, and not an overpriced course that drains your savings, but a disciplined, mathematical roadmap engineered specifically for accounts starting as low as $500. I know how devastating it feels to blow up a small trading account, because I stood on the losing end myself in the past. Most trading rooms destroy small accounts because they call out $1,000+ options contracts meant for six-figure portfolios, where one normal dip wipes out 50% of a beginner's capital. Even worse, fake gurus charge $3,000 for repainted "holy grail" indicators, stealing the very capital you needed to trade with. That is why I built Revolution Trading Pros on one unbreakable rule: we put people over profits. Mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading", I brought institutional order-flow discipline to self-directed traders: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). In this room, we apply that exact institutional discipline to help you protect and compound a $500+ account step by step. "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. A $500 account traded with Goldman Sachs risk discipline will beat an undisciplined $50,000 gambler every single time. We are the revolution!" Explore the Small Accounts Room Concept See the $500 to $25,000+ Roadmap Starting Capital Built for $500+ Accounts PDT & Settlement T+1 Cash Account Mastery Contract Selection Affordable & High Liquidity Risk Architecture Exact Entries, Targets & Stops Small-Capital Engineering The 4 Laws of $500+ Account Survival Zero Gambling Why do 90% of small accounts fail in their first 30 days? Because they copy big-account sizing. Every setup in our Small Accounts Room obeys four non-negotiable laws: Law 01 // Strict Contract Affordability No Oversized Contracts We filter specifically for liquid stock, ETF, and options setups where contract premiums or vertical spreads fit cleanly inside a $500 to $2,500 budget. Law 02 // T+1 Cash Account Rotation Bypass PDT Locks Learn how to partition your settled cash under T+1 overnight settlement so you can execute intraday setups every morning without needing $25,000 margin. Law 03 // Asymmetric 3R to 5R Payoffs Defined Risk Only By entering at institutional liquidity sweeps with tight invalidation stops, your downside is capped to a small fraction while winners compound aggressively. Law 04 // Pre-Planned Entries, Exits & Stops Zero Guesswork Every trade includes the exact entry trigger, profit target, and hard stop-loss level before we enter, eliminating emotional panic selling. Want to calculate exact contract risk before entering? Use our free Options Calculator → Step-by-Step Capital Scaling • Mathematical Discipline The 4-Stage Small Account Compounding Blueprint ($500 to $25,000+) You don’t grow a $500 account by swinging for home runs on every candle. You grow it by graduating through four distinct capital brackets, each with its own position-sizing and risk rules: Stage 01 // Survival & Stabilization $500 to $1,500 Capital Halting Account Bleed, T+1 Cash Account Rotation & Contract Affordability When you start with $500, a single reckless $300 loss destroys 60% of your buying power and requires a 150% gain just to get back to breakeven. Stage 01 installs ironclad capital protection and teaches you how to rotate settled cash daily under T+1 settlement rules without triggering Pattern Day Trader (PDT) locks. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Strict contract price ceiling so no single option contract consumes your account T+1 Cash Account buying-power partitioning (trading 30% to 50% of settled cash per session) Mandatory hard stop-losses placed in the system the second an order fillsStage 02 // Structured Compounding $1,500 to $5,000 Capital Asymmetric 3R+ Setups, Vertical Spreads & Runner Mechanics Once your base capital is protected and growing, you unlock multi-contract scaling and defined-risk vertical debit/credit spreads. Instead of binary "all-in / all-out" trades, you learn to lock in profit on Contract 1 to finance a risk-free runner. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Transitioning from single-contract entries to 2-contract scale-out structures Using vertical debit spreads to cap maximum dollar risk and neutralize Theta decay Moving stops to breakeven immediately after Target 1 is achievedStage 03 // Multi-Strategy Expansion $5,000 to $15,000 Capital Combining Intraday Liquidity Sweeps With Multi-Day Institutional Swings With a $5,000+ cushion, your account no longer depends solely on intraday scalps. We teach you to allocate a core bucket to multi-day institutional swing setups while keeping a tactical bucket for high-velocity opening bell setups. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Splitting capital between intraday cash-flow setups and multi-day swing runners Applying the macro regime framework behind our 2020 and 2022 top and bottom calls Strict daily drawdown circuit breakers to protect weeks of accumulated gainsStage 04 // Institutional Graduation $15,000 to $25,000+ Capital Crossing the $25,000 Threshold Without Developing Reckless Size Habits Many traders work hard to grow a small account to $25,000, unlock margin day trading, and immediately blow it up by 5x-ing their position size overnight. We guide your transition into full institutional sizing with mathematical precision. Mandatory Bracket Rules: Gradual percentage-based position scaling so emotions never spike with dollar size Full integration with our main Day Trading Room and Swing Trading Room playbooks Portfolio-level hedging using index puts and contrarian distribution setups Goldman Sachs Mentored Execution • Right-Sized for Small Capital Four Institutional Setups Engineered Specifically for $500+ Accounts We never water down our institutional edge for small accounts; we right-size the vehicle. Here are the four core playbooks we execute inside the Small Accounts Room: Playbook 01 // T+1 Cash Account Liquidity Sweeps Liquid Options & ETFs High-Probability Opening Bell Reversals Priced for $500+ Accounts Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Small account traders chase expensive, high-implied-volatility options contracts ($8.00 to $15.00 per contract) right as retail FOMO peaks at the open. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: Using the proprietary order-flow methodology passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we wait for institutional liquidity sweeps on liquid ETFs and stocks where clean, tight-spread options contracts cost a fraction of the price. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Tight structural invalidation levels just beyond the sweep high/low, keeping dollar risk small while targeting 200% to 300% asymmetric expansions.Playbook 02 // Defined-Risk Vertical Spreads Debit & Credit Spreads Capping Maximum Risk & Defeating Options Time Decay (Theta) Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Beginners buy cheap, far out-of-the-money weekly lottery-ticket calls or puts that have a 95% probability of expiring worthless due to rapid time decay. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: We teach small accounts how to pair a long option with a short option (vertical spreads), drastically lowering the cost of entry, neutralizing time decay, and supporting profitable execution even on moderate price moves. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Maximum possible loss is 100% locked in and known before entry, with zero margin surprises and zero Theta bleed traps.Playbook 03 // Contrarian Distribution Puts The +600% OXY Blueprint Turning Small Defined Risk Into Explosive Gains When Hype Collapses Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Retail traders with $500 accounts buy late into media hype, becoming exit liquidity for billionaires and institutional desks. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: This is the exact blueprint behind our famous Occidental Petroleum (OXY) trade: while Warren Buffett bought millions of dollars on the long side and retail chased the headline, we spotted institutional distribution and bought affordable OXY Put Options live for a 600% overnight gain. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Strictly defined premium risk on liquid put contracts when institutional volume confirms buyer exhaustion at major resistance.Playbook 04 // High-Velocity Small-Cap & ETF Swings Shares & Multi-Day Options Capturing 3-to-5 Day Compression Breakouts Without PDT Restrictions Why Most $500 Accounts Blow Up Here: Traders in margin accounts under $25,000 get locked by the 3-day-trade Pattern Day Trader (PDT) rule or hold losing day trades overnight hoping to avoid a PDT strike. Our Institutional Small-Account Solution: We provide pre-planned 2-to-5 day swing setups with exact entry triggers, profit targets, and hard stops that don’t count as day trades, allowing you to compound smoothly whether you use a cash account or a small margin account. Capital Protection & Risk Cap: Pre-calculated share or contract sizing using our free Options Calculator so every trade respects your exact account balance. Hand-selected setups priced specifically for small-account affordability, tight bid-ask spreads, and high liquidity.PDT & T+1 Cash Account Rules Ignores Pattern Day Trader locks and cash settlement rules, leaving small accounts stranded with unsettled funds. Home Swing Trading Room Built for Working Professionals • Multi-Day Stocks, ETFs & Options • US & Canada People Over Profits Mentored by Former Goldman Sachs Legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick Stock, ETF & Options Swing Trading Room for Working Professionals Capture Institutional Multi-Day Moves Without Quitting Your Career or Staring at Screens All Day. When you step into the Revolution Trading Pros Swing Trading Room, you immediately know you finally found what you have been searching for: not hype, not fake "holy grail" repainted indicators, and not impulsive alerts you miss while at work, but pre-planned institutional swing execution built around your real life. I know what it feels like to be on the losing end of the market, because I stood there myself in the past. I know the frustration of working hard at your job, buying an overpriced course from an internet guru, and watching your swing trades get chopped to pieces because nobody taught you institutional accumulation, options time-decay control, or hard stop-losses. That is why we built this room with one uncompromising rule: we put people over profits. Directly mentored by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading giant Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who explicitly called me "the future of trading", I brought institutional order-flow discipline to self-directed traders: calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Bull Market Top and Bear Bottom, and executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade during high-volume institutional distribution for a reported 600% overnight gain (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results). Now, we hand you that exact multi-day institutional playbook in 15 to 20 minutes a day. "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. You don't need six monitors or eight free hours a day to trade like a Goldman Sachs prop desk—you need pre-planned institutional structure, exact entries, and ironclad stops." Explore the Swing Trading Room Concept See the 20-Minute Working Pro Routine Ideal Trader Profile 9-to-5 Pros & Swing Traders Typical Hold Duration 2 Days to 3+ Weeks Daily Time Required 15–20 Mins Pre-Planned Risk Architecture Exact Entries, Targets & Stops 9-to-5 Execution Architecture How Every Swing Setup Is Delivered Set & Execute You never have to panic-buy a moving candle from a meeting room. Every multi-day stock, ETF, and options swing trade is mapped out ahead of time with five institutional coordinates: 01 // Macro & Sector Thesis Video + Chart Markup Full breakdown of institutional accumulation or distribution, sector relative strength, and why smart money is positioning for a multi-day move. 02 // Exact Entry Trigger Zone Conditional Order Ready The exact price level and volume confirmation required to trigger the swing, allowing you to place limit or stop-limit orders before work. 03 // Options Contract or Equity Structure Zero Theta Traps Exact strike, expiration date (with ample time cushion), or vertical/diagonal spread structure so overnight holds never bleed out to time decay. 04 // Hard Stop-Loss & Tiered Profit Targets 3R–5R Asymmetry Pre-defined invalidation stop-loss level plus Target 1, Target 2, and trailing runner zones so your downside is capped and your upside compounds. Only want the video watchlist & alerts without the full room? See Sunday Alpha Protocol → Engineered for Busy Careers • Zero Screen Addiction The 20-Minute Working Professional Swing Trading Workflow You don’t lose to Wall Street because you have a full-time job. You lose when you try to day trade on a 5-minute break without a plan. Here is how our members trade institutional swings alongside demanding careers: Phase 01 // Sunday & Evening Macro Prep 20 Mins Evening Review Top-Down Macro Regime, Sector Rotation & Institutional Watchlist Before the trading week begins, and each evening after the market closes, we map where institutional capital is rotating across indexes, sector ETFs, and leading stocks so you never have to scramble at the 9:30 AM opening bell. Included in Your Room Membership: Macro breadth, volatility regime, and institutional accumulation/distribution read Focused multi-day watchlist of high-liquidity stocks, ETFs, and options structures Complete video and chart walkthroughs available on demand around your work and family schedulePhase 02 // Pre-Planned Order Structuring 10 Mins Pre-Market or Mobile Exact Trigger Entries, Tiered Profit Targets & Hard Stop-Losses Because you have a career or business to run, every swing setup is delivered well ahead of the trigger with exact price coordinates. You can input conditional orders on your phone or desktop in minutes and go back to your day. Included in Your Room Membership: Exact entry trigger zone instead of vague "watch this ticker" commentary Specific options contract structure (strike, expiration, delta, and debit/credit spread selection) Pre-calculated hard invalidation stop-loss and tiered profit-taking targets (Target 1, Target 2, Runner)Phase 03 // Multi-Day Position Management Real-Time Room & Alert Updates Scaling Out Into Strength, Trailing Stops & Overnight Risk Control Capturing 3-to-15-day institutional swings requires knowing when to lock in partial profits, when to raise stops to breakeven, and how to hedge overnight macro catalysts without getting shaken out by normal intraday noise. Included in Your Room Membership: Instant room updates whenever a swing setup triggers, hits Target 1, or adjusts its trailing stop Options time-decay (Theta) and implied volatility (Vega) protection rules for multi-day holds Portfolio-level exposure limits so you never over-concentrate in a single sectorPhase 04 // Interactive Desk Reviews & Q&A Live & Recorded Sessions Deep-Dive Chart Diagnostics, Open Position Audits & Member Q&A Unlike one-way alert newsletters that leave you guessing, the Swing Trading Room gives you direct access to our desk to review open positions, diagnose tickers on your personal radar, and master institutional swing mechanics. Included in Your Room Membership: Interactive chart reviews breaking down every open and closed swing trade Full archive of recorded sessions so working professionals in any time zone never miss a setup Direct education on why a setup worked, building your lifelong independence as a trader Goldman Sachs Mentored Methodology • Verified Market Calls Four Institutional Swing Playbooks Forged in Real Market Cycles Simple "buy the dip" retail swing trading gets crushed when volatility expands. Every trade in our Swing Trading Room is governed by one of four institutional playbooks: Playbook 01 // Multi-Week Institutional Accumulation Breakouts Hold: 3 to 15 Trading Days Compression-to-Expansion Breakouts Backed by Smart-Money Volume Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: Retail swing traders buy late into extended 5-day rallies right as institutional algorithms begin distributing shares into retail FOMO. Our Institutional Execution Edge: Using the proprietary order-flow principles passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we identify multi-week institutional accumulation bases and enter as smart-money volume ignites out of compression. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: Hard stop placed below the institutional accumulation shelf, targeting a minimum 3:1 to 5:1 reward-to-risk expansion.Playbook 02 // Contrarian Distribution & Liquidity Exhaustion Swings Hold: 1 to 10 Trading Days The +600% OXY Put Options Playbook: Fading Retail Euphoria at Structural Tops Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: When mainstream financial media celebrates a billionaire headline or earnings hype, retail traders pile in on the long side at the exact top of a liquidity sweep. Our Institutional Execution Edge: This is the exact methodology we used when Warren Buffett went long millions of dollars in Occidental Petroleum (OXY) and we shorted live with OXY Put Options for a 600% overnight gain. We spot institutional distribution hiding behind bullish headlines. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: Defined-risk put options or put debit spreads with capped downside and explosive asymmetric payoff during multi-day unwinds.Playbook 03 // Macro Inflection & Sector Rotation Swings Hold: 1 to 4 Weeks Riding Major Regime Shifts Using Our 2020 & 2022 Cycle Framework Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: Most swing services use static bull-market rules that get obliterated when the macro regime flips from accumulation to bear distribution. Our Institutional Execution Edge: Anchored in the exact macro timing framework that called the 2020 COVID top and bottom and the 2022 bull market top and bear market bottom, we rotate capital into leading sectors or pivot to index/sector puts when macro breadth breaks. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: Top-down sector relative strength filtering combined with trailing structural stops behind daily and weekly higher lows.Playbook 04 // Asymmetric Options Spreads & Time-Decay Control Hold: 3 to 21 Trading Days Structuring Calls, Puts, Verticals & Diagonals That Survive Overnight Noise Why Retail Swing Traders Get Trapped: Amateurs buy short-dated, far out-of-the-money weekly options for swing trades and lose money to Theta decay even when the stock moves in their direction. Our Institutional Execution Edge: We structure swing options positions with institutional precision, selecting the right expiration window, delta profile, or vertical/diagonal spread so time decay and implied volatility work in your favor. Risk, Stop-Loss & Options Structure: 100% defined capital at risk per trade, with your maximum dollar risk known before you ever submit the order. The Anti-Guru Standard • Hard Evidence Why Most Swing Trading Alert Services Fail Working Professionals and How We Protect You Compare the typical retail stock-picking newsletter against the institutional discipline inside the Revolution Trading Pros Swing Trading Room: Comparison StandardTypical "Guru" Swing Newsletters & IndicatorsRevolution Trading Pros Swing Trading RoomCore Ethical Priority Selling $3,000 upsell courses and $2,000 repainted "holy grail" swing indicators. Because our mentorship is strictly 1-on-1, your curriculum, risk architecture, and live drills are custom-engineered around one of three dedicated tracks: Track 01 // Institutional & Capital Allocators Portfolio Managers & Family Offices Portfolio Managers & Desk Leads Macro Regime Timing, Asymmetric Options Overlays & Drawdown Protection The Bottleneck Holding You Back: Conventional buy-and-hold models and lagging street research leave portfolios exposed at major macro inflection points, suffering severe drawdowns during liquidity cascades like 2020 and 2022 while missing asymmetric contrarian opportunities. Our 1-on-1 Institutional Intervention: We install the exact proprietary macro cycle and order-flow framework passed down by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, the same methodology that called the 2020 COVID top and bottom, the 2022 bull top and bear bottom, and our 600% overnight OXY Put Options trade against Warren Buffett’s long position. Core 1-on-1 Deliverables: Macro Regime & Liquidity Inflection Framework: Identify institutional distribution tops and capitulation bottoms before consensus research reacts. Asymmetric Options Hedging & Alpha Overlays: Structure defined-risk put spreads, collars, and volatility skew trades to monetize downside cascades. Execution & Liquidity Sweep Telemetry: Enter and exit large equity, ETF, and index options positions using institutional absorption zones. Direct 1-on-1 Desk Consultation: Private weekly strategy reviews tailored to your mandate, risk tolerance, and capital allocation rules. Preview the Portfolio Manager Track Track 02 // Full-Time & Prop Execution Professional & Active Traders Professional Traders Breaking PnL Plateaus, Scaling Size & Mastering Institutional Order Flow The Bottleneck Holding You Back: You already know how to read charts and generate winning weeks, but you hit an invisible ceiling when scaling contract or share size, giving back weeks of gains on low-quality chop days or hesitating on A+ institutional setups. Our 1-on-1 Institutional Intervention: We perform a forensic audit of your trade ledger, strip out low-expectancy setups, and upgrade your execution with zero-repaint institutional telemetry, options volatility structuring, and Goldman Sachs prop-desk sizing mathematics. Core 1-on-1 Deliverables: Forensic Trade Ledger & Expectancy Audit: Pinpoint the exact time-of-day, instrument, and behavioral leaks capping your equity curve. Institutional Order Flow & Trap Recognition: Spot where retail breakout traders are trapped and execute alongside smart-money liquidity sweeps. Conviction Sizing & Scaling Architecture: Mathematical rules for pressing A+ setups with size while keeping B-grade chop exposure near zero. Live Market Co-Execution Drills: Real-time 1-on-1 feedback on entries, tiered profit scaling, and dynamic stop management. Preview the Professional Trader Track Track 03 // Complete Retail Turnaround Struggling Traders Seeking Rescue Struggling Traders Stop the Bleeding, Unlearn Fake Guru Lies & Rebuild With Mechanical Discipline The Bottleneck Holding You Back: You have bought overpriced courses and fake "holy grail" repainted indicators, jumped from strategy to strategy, and watched your hard-earned account bleed out through FOMO, hesitation, and undefined risk. Our 1-on-1 Institutional Intervention: Because our founder stood on the losing end in the past before being mentored by Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we know exactly how to pull you out of the retail trap. Most trading education services are built with a single, predatory goal: extract as much money from you as possible by selling overpriced courses and fake "holy grail" indicators. Revolution Trading Pros was built to burn that model to the ground. Because I have stood on the losing end of the market in the past, I know the sickening feeling of trusting a "guru" only to realize their indicators repaint and their trade calls are hindsight lies. When former Wall Street Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick mentored me directly and called me "the future of trading," I made a vow: I would bring real Wall Street execution to everyday people at a price anyone can afford. Whether we are calling the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, calling the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, or executing a contrarian defined-risk OXY put options trade for a reported 600% overnight gain into institutional distribution (educational historical example; past performance does not guarantee future results), our mission never changes: Educate, Innovate, and Prosper. We vet and approve every candidate by hand. Read the Founder’s Reported Background Exposing the Industry Lie • Hard Evidence Why 95% of Trading Education Services Want You to Stay Dependent and Why We Refuse To understand our mission, you have to confront the ugly truth about how most online trading educators in the United States and Canada actually make their money. Industry Trap #1 Exposed The $2,500 "Holy Grail" Indicator Scam Marketers code lagging oscillators that rewrite their signals after the candle closes, slap a "94% Accuracy" label on a sales page, and charge desperate traders thousands of dollars. When you load that indicator in a live market, it whipsaws your account to zero. Our Solution: Every custom indicator and institutional scanner we engineer is 100% non-repainting, built to expose real institutional order flow, abandoned price bars, and liquidity sweeps at a fair price. Industry Trap #2 Exposed Vague Alerts With No Stops or Risk Parameters Most alert rooms shout out 20 tickers at the open with zero entry triggers and zero stop-loss levels. If 18 fail and 2 go up, the guru brags about the 2 winners all week while members silently bleed out on the 18 losers. Our Solution: In our live rooms and our affordable alert-only tiers (Sunday Alpha Protocol & SPX Profit Pulse), we deliver detailed video watchlists with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard invalidation stops ahead of time. Industry Trap #3 Exposed Pricing Out $500 Accounts & Working Families Traditional trading rooms cater exclusively to wealthy day traders who can sit at six monitors all day and absorb $2,000 drawdowns, leaving working parents and $500 starter accounts to blow up trying to copy oversized trades. Our Solution: We built the Small Accounts Room specifically for accounts starting as low as $500, and the Swing Trading Room for working professionals who need multi-day precision. Our Core Slogan in Action Educate. Innovate. Prosper. How Our Three Pillars Transform Traders "Educate, Innovate, and Prosper" isn't a marketing catchphrase; it is the exact three-stage engineering blueprint behind every room, alert service, and tool at Revolution Trading Pros. Pillar 01 // Truth Over Textbook Theory Educate. Teach Real Institutional Market Mechanics Without Recycled Retail Hype Retail traders lose because they are taught lagging retail patterns that institutional algorithms actively hunt. We educate our members using the exact order flow, liquidity exhaustion, and asymmetric risk principles passed down from former Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick. The Member Outcome: From $500 starter accounts to full-time professionals, every member learns why a trade works before risking a single dollar. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Structured Trading Courses Small Accounts Room ($500+) Market Intelligence Blogs Pillar 02 // Zero-Repaint Precision Telemetry Innovate. Build Honest, Non-Repainting Indicators, Scanners & Free Public Tools The trading industry is flooded with $2,000 "holy grail" indicators engineered to repaint arrows after the candle closes so marketers can film fake promotional videos. We innovate by building 100% non-repainting custom indicators, live institutional scanners, and free public calculators that print objective truth in real time. The Member Outcome: Every signal, liquidity zone, and abandoned price bar prints live and stays on the chart permanently, giving you verifiable clarity. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Custom Non-Repainting Indicators Institutional Market Scanners Free Options Calculator Pillar 03 // People Over Profits Prosper. Deliver Affordable Live Execution & Exact Video Watchlists So Members Thrive Education and tools mean nothing if subscription fees drain your trading capital. We keep our live trading rooms and alert services genuinely affordable, delivering real-time intraday execution and detailed video watchlists with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard stop-losses. The Member Outcome: Whether you trade live with us at the opening bell or execute swings around a 9-to-5 career, our only metric of success is your consistency. Direct Ecosystem Pathways: Live Day Trading Room Swing Trading Room Sunday Alpha Protocol Video Watchlist Accountability Written in Stone Six Ironclad Promises We Make to Every Trader Who Walks Through Our Doors The proposed Revolution Trading Pros concept is intended to support an institution governed by six unbreakable commitments to your success. Commitment #01 Ethical Pricing Standard Radical Affordability: Keep Your Capital in Your Brokerage Account What Broken Services Do: Fake gurus charge $3,000 to $10,000 for basic courses, stripping new traders of the very capital they need to trade. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We price our Live Trading Rooms, Alert Services (SPX Profit Pulse & Sunday Alpha Protocol), Courses, Indicators, and Scanners for maximum accessibility because we make our living from the market, not from gouging students.Commitment #02 Zero Repainting Law No Fake "Holy Grail" Indicators. Ever. What Broken Services Do: Predatory indicator sellers market scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight and leave traders trapped in live market chop. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We will never sell you a "magic buy/sell arrow" fantasy. Every custom indicator and scanner in our Store is 100% non-repainting and built on real institutional volume, price structure, and liquidity exhaustion.Commitment #03 Pre-Trade Accountability Exact Entries, Profit Targets & Hard Stops Before the Move Happens What Broken Services Do: Internet marketers post winning screenshots after the market closes without ever defining risk ahead of time. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: Every setup called in our rooms or delivered in our video watchlists defines the exact entry trigger, tiered profit targets, and hard invalidation stop-loss before execution, the same standard behind our 2020, 2022, and +600% OXY Put Options calls.Commitment #04 Complete Inclusivity No Trader Left Behind: From $500 Small Accounts to Working Pros What Broken Services Do: Most trading rooms force a single reckless style that blows up $500 accounts and excludes people with full-time 9-to-5 jobs. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: We maintain dedicated environments for every reality: the Small Accounts Room for $500+ capital, the Swing Trading Room and Sunday Alpha Protocol alerts for working professionals, and the Day Trading Room and SPX Profit Pulse for intraday traders.Commitment #05 Merit Over Money 1-on-1 Mentorship by Application and Approval Only What Broken Services Do: Traditional coaching programs accept anyone whose credit card clears, regardless of whether the student is ready. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: You cannot buy your way into our 1-on-1 Mentorship off the shelf. Every applicant is manually reviewed and approved based on coachability, discipline, and work ethic, proving we care about transformation over revenue.Commitment #06 Earned Authority Battle-Tested Wall Street Lineage & Live Market Proof What Broken Services Do: Unqualified educators teach theory they have never executed against institutional order flow. Our Ironclad Commitment to You: Every lesson we teach is anchored in lived market combat, forged by standing on the losing side first, being mentored by Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, and executing live through the 2020 and 2022 macro turns. Your comprehensive reference guide to Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). Explore the 12 most heavily traded flagship ETFs, inspect all 11 official S&P 500 GICS Sectors, compare ETFs against mutual funds, and learn how institutional desks use ETFs for intraday scalping, 9-to-5 swing trading, and $500+ small account compounding. Mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called our founder "the future of trading", we track ETF order flow every single morning before the opening bell. Because institutional balance sheets deploy billions of dollars through index and sector ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM, XLE, XLK, XLF), reading ETF accumulation and distribution is how we called the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, called the 2022 Bull Market Top and Bear Bottom, and spotted the energy sector distribution that fueled our live +600% overnight gain on OXY Put Options. Explore Popular ETFs Directory ↓ Jump to All 11 Sector ETFs ↓ Free Options Risk Calculator → Desk Execution Cheat Sheet How Our Desk Uses ETFs Daily Zero Single-Stock Gap Risk 01 // Opening-Bell & 0DTE Options Scalping SPY, QQQ & IWM offer penny-wide bid-ask spreads, daily expirations, and predictable dealer Gamma walls for our Day Trading Room. 02 // 9-to-5 Working Professional Swings Sector ETFs (XLK, XLE, XLF, SMH, GLD) eliminate single-company CEO or earnings blowup risk, making them ideal for our Swing Trading Room and Sunday Alpha Protocol. 03 // $500+ Small Account Compounding Lower-priced, high-liquidity ETFs like IWM, XLF, EEM, and XLE offer affordable options contracts and tight vertical spreads for our Small Accounts Room. 04 // Sibling Market Reference Lists Pair this ETF directory with our Stock Indexes List (SPX, NDX, DJI, RUT, VIX) and our Live Market Scanners. Foundation & Mechanics • Complete Breakdown What Is an Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF)? Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) are SEC- and IIROC-regulated investment vehicles that trade on stock exchanges throughout the market day, just like individual stocks. Each ETF holds an underlying basket of assets, such as an equity index, an economic sector, Treasury bonds, or physical commodities, allowing traders and investors to capture broad market trends or hedge risk through a single liquid ticker. Benefit #01 ✓ Instant Basket Diversification (Zero Single-Stock Earnings Shock) An ETF holds a basket of dozens or hundreds of companies. If one company suffers an overnight CEO scandal or earnings miss, your ETF position is insulated from single-stock wipeout risk.Benefit #02 ✓ Tradable Intraday Like Stocks + Deep Options Chains Unlike mutual funds that only settle after the 4:00 PM ET close, ETFs trade tick-by-tick all day with limit orders, stop-loss orders, and some of the tightest options bid-ask spreads in the world.Benefit #03 ✓ Ultra-Low Expense Ratios Because most index and sector ETFs passively track a rules-based benchmark rather than paying an expensive mutual fund manager, annual expense ratios are often as low as 0.03% to 0.10%.Benefit #04 ✓ Daily Holdings & Institutional Flow Transparency ETFs publish their exact constituent holdings and weightings daily, allowing our scanners and indicators to track exactly which top-weighted stocks are driving sector rotation.Benefit #05 ✓ Superior Tax Efficiency (In-Kind Creation/Redemption) Through institutional in-kind creation and redemption mechanics, ETFs rarely distribute surprise year-end capital gains taxes the way traditional mutual funds do. Asset Class Taxonomy The 5 Primary Types of ETFs Traded on Institutional Desks Type 01 SPY, QQQ, IWM, VTI, DIA Broad Market & Index Stock ETFs Track flagship equity indexes (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000), offering the deepest intraday volume and daily/0DTE options chains.Type 02 XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV, SMH, XBI Sector & Industry ETFs Isolate the 11 S&P 500 GICS sectors or high-velocity sub-industries (semiconductors, biotech, oil & gas, regional banks) to ride institutional sector rotation.Type 03 AGG, TLT, IEF, HYG, LQD Bond & Fixed-Income ETFs Provide liquid stock-exchange access to U.S. Treasuries, investment-grade corporate debt, and high-yield credit, critical for tracking macro interest-rate regimes.Type 04 GLD, SLV, USO, UNG, DBA Commodity & Hard-Asset ETFs Track physical gold, silver, crude oil, natural gas, or agriculture without needing a futures brokerage account or taking physical delivery.Type 05 EEM, EFA, VEA, FXI, EWZ International & Emerging Market ETFs Deliver instant geographic exposure to European, Asian, and Latin American equity markets directly from a standard U.S. or Canadian brokerage account. Click Ticker to Open Live Chart: XLRE ↗VNQ ↗IYR ↗ Structural Comparison • Hard Evidence ETFs vs. Mutual Funds: Why Active Traders & Options Strategists Choose ETFs Both ETFs and mutual funds hold baskets of securities, but their execution mechanics, tax treatment, and options capabilities are fundamentally different: Comparison FeatureExchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)Traditional Mutual FundsIntraday Execution & Order Control✓ Traded live tick-by-tick all day with limit, stop-loss, and conditional ordersBought or sold only once per day after the 4:00 PM ET market close at NAVOptions Trading Compatibility✓ Full options chains (Calls, Puts, Verticals, 0DTE & Weeklies on major ETFs)No options chains, so it is impossible to trade calls, puts, or credit spreadsMinimum Capital Requirement✓ No fund minimum: buy 1 share or 1 affordable option contract in a $500+ accountOften enforces $500 to $3,000+ minimum initial investment lockupsAnnual Expense Ratios✓ Typically ultra-low (0.03% to 0.20% for core index and sector ETFs)Frequently higher (0.50% to 1.25%+) plus potential front/back-end sales loadsTax Efficiency✓ In-kind creation/redemption structure minimizes taxable capital gains distributionsPooled redemptions trigger mandatory year-end taxable capital gainsManagement Style Primarily rules-based index tracking (with select active thematic funds)Available in both passive index and active manager mandatesBest Suited For Active day traders, 9-to-5 swing traders, options strategists & cost-conscious investorsHands-off 401(k) retirement savers executing automated bi-weekly payroll contributions Active Execution & Options ETFs Are Ideal For: Cost-conscious investors, 9-to-5 swing traders, $500+ small accounts, and options traders who require intraday liquidity, exact stop-loss control, and deep call/put chains. Passive Payroll Retirement Mutual Funds Are Suited For: Hands-off 401(k) participants who only execute automated bi-weekly payroll contributions and never trade intraday or use options strategies. Direct Answers • Zero Fluff Frequently Asked Questions About Trading ETFs & Sector Rotation Which ETFs are best for trading options in a $500+ small account? + For accounts starting between $500 and $2,500, we focus on ETFs that combine penny-wide bid-ask spreads with affordable contract prices: IWM (Russell 2000), XLF (Financials), XLE (Energy), GLD (Gold), and EEM (Emerging Markets), as well as defined-risk vertical spreads on SPY and QQQ.Why do institutional traders and working professionals prefer Sector ETFs over single stocks? + Single stocks carry overnight idiosyncratic risk (such as an unexpected FDA rejection, SEC probe, or earnings gap). Sector ETFs like XLK, XLE, XLF, and SMH allow 9-to-5 working professionals to trade the dominant institutional money flow with smooth technical structure and zero single-company blowup risk.What is the difference between SPY and SPX when trading S&P 500 options? + SPY is an Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) priced at roughly 1/10th the S&P 500 Index with American-style share settlement and dividend payments. Understand how indexes work, track market performance, and discover the best ways to gain exposure. Authored by Billy Ribeiro • Updated October 31, 2026 Featured Index S&P 500 Index The S&P 500 is a prominent stock index that tracks the 500 largest companies listed on major U.S. exchanges, such as the NYSE and NASDAQ. This index is weighted based on the total market capitalization of each company's outstanding shares, which means it offers a comprehensive representation of the overall U.S. stock market, more so than other indexes like the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) or the Russell 2000. Recognized globally as one of the most influential stock indexes, the S&P 500 is market capitalization-weighted. This indicates that companies with larger market values have a more significant impact on the index's overall performance compared to smaller companies. In essence, bigger companies exert more influence over the market's overall movement. Pro Tip: Investors aiming for exposure to large-cap stocks (such as Apple or Microsoft) might find it beneficial to invest in ETFs like VOO or IVV rather than picking individual stocks for their portfolio. To closely monitor market trends, $SPY and $ES (S&P 500 futures) are commonly used instruments. Having a chart of either SPY or SPY futures is crucial when trading stocks, as the majority of stocks tend to move in tandem with the broader market. What are the three major stock indexes? 1. S&P 500: measures 500 large-caps in U.S. stock market2. Dow Jones 30: measures the top 30 U.S. large-cap stocks3. Nasdaq 100: measures the top 100 largest non-financial companies What is the difference between a stock and an index? A stock allows investors partial ownership in a company. An index gives investors the option of investing in a basket of companies through products like ETFs, mutual funds, and derivatives. Can you invest directly in an index? An index cannot be traded or invested in directly. Many different products, such as ETFs, mutual funds, and derivatives, are available to investors to gain exposure to index performance. What are the ticker symbols for major indexes? 1. S&P 500 – SPX or $SPX2. Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) – $DJI3. Nasdaq Composite – COMPQ or $COMPQ4. NYSE Composite – (DJ)5. Russell 2000 – RUT or $RUT What is the most widely cited US stock market index? Our On-Chart Stats Engine analyzes the historical data of the exact symbol and timeframe on your screen and prints a live quantitative dashboard at the top of your chart. You see the average percentage and dollar move, how many bars the average setup lasts before firing, and how many fired long versus short. In this comprehensive Accelerator Class, Billy Ribeiro breaks down the exact institutional framework passed down by former Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick. You learn how to read pre-breakout absorption, structure asymmetric options contracts, and set mechanical entry triggers, profit targets, and hard stop-losses. EXECUTIONExact Entry,Target & Stop Works on Stocks, ETFs, SPX & Options Included in Package ↑Component 02 // Primary Core Telemetry Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView • 100% Non-Repainting Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra Indicator Three Dynamic Volatility & Liquidity Filters That Adapt Automatically to Any Market Regime Standard retail indicators use static formulas that fail the moment market volatility shifts. The NEW Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra Indicator automatically calibrates to real-time institutional volume, liquidity sweeps, and volatility compression across three distinct intensity tiers (Low, High, and Ultra Compression). Once a candle closes, the signal never repaints, giving you objective clarity on when smart money is accumulating and when momentum is exhausting. Why Options & Equity Traders Love This: Built-in audio and visual alerts notify you the exact second an institutional compression or liquidity sweep triggers. ✓ Three dynamic compression and institutional absorption filters calibrated for stocks, ETFs, and indexes✓ 100% non-repainting code with zero lookahead bias and zero erased losing signals✓ Plots automatic structural invalidation levels so you always know where your hard stop-loss belongs Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra Indicator 100% Non-Repainting ULTRA FILTER FIRED ▲ Works on Stocks, ETFs, SPX & Options Included in Package ↑Component 03 // 18-Timeframe Alignment Grid Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView Multi-Timeframe Compression & Order Flow Matrix The Most Explosive Moves Happen When Multiple Timeframes Compress and Fire Together A 5-minute setup fighting a bearish daily chart is a low-probability gamble. When a 5-minute, 15-minute, 1-hour, and Daily chart align in simultaneous institutional compression, the resulting move is explosive. Our Multi-Timeframe Matrix condenses up to 18 timeframes into a clean, simplified on-chart telemetry ribbon so you never trade against higher-timeframe institutional flow again. Why Options & Equity Traders Love This: Eliminates flipping between 10 different chart tabs, ideal for both 9-to-5 working professionals and opening-bell scalpers. ✓ Tracks simultaneous compression and trend alignment from 1-minute scalping charts up to Weekly macro charts✓ Simplified, high-contrast status labels showing exact multi-timeframe confluence in seconds✓ Prevents chop-zone overtrading by warning you when higher timeframes are in conflict Multi-Timeframe Compression & Order Flow Matrix 100% Non-Repainting 18-TIMEFRAME SYNCHRONIZED CONFLUENCE MATRIXINTRADAY (1M • 3M • 5M • 15M • 30M): ULTRA COMPRESSION ALIGNEDSWING (1H • 2H • 4H • DAILY): BULLISH INSTITUTIONAL THRUSTMACRO (WEEKLY • MONTHLY): ACCUMULATION ZONE VERIFIEDVERDICT: A+ MULTI-TIMEFRAME ALIGNMENT Works on Stocks, ETFs, SPX & Options Included in Package ↑Component 04 // On-Chart Quantitative Expectancy Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView On-Chart Historical Expectancy & Squeeze Stats Engine Plan Every Trade Using Real Historical Expectancy Data Specific to the Exact Ticker & Timeframe on Your Screen Stop guessing how far a setup might run or which option expiration to buy. Our On-Chart Stats Engine analyzes the historical data of the exact symbol and timeframe on your screen and prints a live quantitative dashboard at the top of your chart. You see the average percentage and dollar move, how many bars the average setup lasts before firing, and how many fired long versus short. Why Options & Equity Traders Love This: Note: Options traders love this tool because knowing the average move magnitude and duration tells you the exact strike price (Delta) and expiration window (DTE) to select! ✓ Measures stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures on any timeframe automatically✓ Displays Average Gain, Average Duration (in bars), and Long vs. Short Historical Firing Ratio at a glance✓ Prevents buying overpriced out-of-the-money options beyond a ticker’s realistic historical expectancy On-Chart Historical Expectancy & Squeeze Stats Engine 100% Non-Repainting ON-CHART STATS ENGINE (AUTO-CALCULATED PER TICKER)AVG MOVE: +$6.40 (+3.8%) | AVG DURATION: 8.5 BARS79.4%HISTORICAL FIRED LONGIN UPTREND REGIME30–45 DTEOPTIMAL OPTIONS WINDOW0.60 DELTA SWEET SPOT Works on Stocks, ETFs, SPX & Options Included in Package ↑Component 05 // Included Bonus Indicator Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView + Dedicated Install Session BONUS: MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro Leading Telemetry Get Into Institutional Moves Earlier and Lock In Profits Before the Reversal Wipes Out Your Gains Included as a dedicated bonus in both packages, MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro is calibrated directly to our three compression tiers. First, it detects quiet institutional block accumulation during the final bars of compression so you can position early with tight risk. Second, it flags momentum deceleration and abandoned price bars at the extreme of the move, helping you scale out at peak premium before the pullback begins. Why Options & Equity Traders Love This: Includes our Step-by-Step Indicator Installation Session & Workspace Templates so your charts are configured in minutes. ✓ Early pre-ignition institutional accumulation alerts before standard breakout traders react✓ Dynamic exhaustion signals to lock in options premium while implied volatility (Vega) is still expanding✓ Complete workspace setup templates + step-by-step installation walkthrough BONUS: MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro Leading Telemetry 100% Non-Repainting 1. Here is what you master inside the 6-module class: Module 01 Foundation & Mechanics The Goldman Sachs Prop Framework: Why Retail Breakouts Fail & How Institutional Compression Works Understand how institutional algorithms accumulate positions inside tight volatility ranges and sweep retail stops before launching a directional trend. Module Deliverables: ■ Anatomy of the 3 compression tiers (Low, High, and Ultra)■ Spotting fake retail breakouts vs. true institutional absorption■ Setting up your ThinkorSwim or TradingView workspace from scratchModule 02 Multi-Timeframe Mastery Stacking the Odds: Using the 18-Timeframe Matrix & MP_EarlyInNOut™ Learn how to align lower-timeframe entry triggers with higher-timeframe institutional trend thrust for maximum win-rate probability. Module Deliverables: ■ The 3-Timeframe Alignment Rule for intraday scalpers and 9-to-5 swing traders■ Using MP_EarlyInNOut™ to enter before the crowd and exit into climax strength■ Filtering out midday chop zones automaticallyModule 03 Quantitative Trade Planning Data-Driven Options Selection Using the On-Chart Historical Stats Engine Turn historical chart statistics into mathematical options structures, matching average setup duration and magnitude to the exact right contract. Module Deliverables: ■ Calculating exact share or contract size in 15 seconds■ Scaling out at Target 1 and Target 2 while trailing stops on runners■ Daily and weekly drawdown circuit breakers that protect your equity curve Goldman Sachs Prop Mentored Creator of The Move Prior to The Move™ People Over Profits About Your Instructor • Verified Pedigree Billy Ribeiro, Founder of Revolution Trading Pros Personally Mentored by Former Goldman Sachs Legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick Unlike internet marketers who have never sat near an institutional desk, and unlike educators who exist only to sell $3,000 courses, Billy Ribeiro built Revolution Trading Pros after standing on the losing end himself early in his career and vowing to protect everyday retail traders from fake "holy grail" scams. I know the pain of getting chopped up by volatile, "go-nowhere" price action and fake repainted arrows, because I stood on the losing end myself in the past. Once I stopped chasing late retail breakouts and was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading", everything changed. Instead of waiting for lagging retail oscillators, this system is engineered to give you an earlier institutional "heads up" that an explosive move is forming, allowing you to get in on the most powerful moves earlier, lock in gains sooner, and avoid midday chop. It is the exact telemetry behind our live calls on the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and our +600% overnight gain on OXY Put Options live opposite Warren Buffett. With The Move Prior to The Move™ Pro System, You Can: ✓ Target big, high-velocity institutional moves and never chase an extended retail candle again✓ Instantly spot multi-level compression and order-flow absorption on ANY chart or timeframe✓ Know the historical "average" profit target and bar duration on ANY ticker at a glance✓ Protect your capital with pre-defined structural invalidation stops before risking a dollar Get Instant Access to the System ↓ Inspect All 6 Included Tools & Bonuses LIVE TELEMETRY PREVIEW ThinkorSwim & TradingView 1. 3 Power Levels 2. Early In/Out 3. Stats Tool 3 DYNAMIC COMPRESSION LEVELS: LOW [○] • HIGH [◐] • ULTRA [●]▲ OBJECTIVE BUY SIGNAL + STOPHARD INVALIDATION STOP-LOSS LEVEL (PLOTTED AUTOMATICALLY) Complete System Inventory What’s Included: ■ The Move Prior to The Move™ Core Indicator (3 Dynamic Compression Levels)■ Objective Buy/Sell & Structural Invalidation Signals■ MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro Leading Accumulation & Exhaustion Telemetry■ On-Chart Historical Expectancy & Move Stats Tool■ 5 Recorded Live-Market Trading Sessions (Real-Time Execution)■ Step-by-Step Quick-Start & Mobile App Installation Guide■ Complete System Strategy Class (On-Demand HD)■ Special Bonus: Precision Options & Equity Entries Masterclass Explore the Proposed Indicator Suite ↓ Complete Institutional Toolkit • Desktop & Mobile When You Sign Up, You Get These 6 Core Indicators, Tools & Exclusive Bonuses We don’t sell you a bare script and leave you guessing how to trade it. The proposed package includes the complete 4-part indicator engine plus 2 recorded live-market training bonuses: Core Engine 01 // Desktop & ThinkorSwim Mobile Ready 100% Non-Repainting The Move Prior to The Move™ Core Indicator (3 Signals in 1) Proposed for ThinkorSwim (Desktop + Mobile App) & TradingView Our flagship breakthrough combines three distinct institutional compression and absorption thresholds (Low, High, and Ultra) into a single non-repainting indicator. It dynamically adapts to faster, slower, and volatile price action, giving you an earlier "heads up" before an explosive directional move fires long or short. The Trader Advantage: Catches high-velocity moves that standard lagging oscillators miss while keeping you out of flat, "go-nowhere" midday chop.Core Engine 02 // Rule-Based Execution 100% Non-Repainting Calibrated Buy/Sell Entry & Invalidation Signals Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView • 100% Non-Repainting Engineered to eliminate hesitation at the moment of execution, these objective entry triggers are specifically calibrated to each of the three compression power levels. Higher-timeframe institutional trend direction and volume structure are automatically factored in. The Trader Advantage: Plots both the exact directional trigger bar and the structural invalidation stop-loss level. Once the candle closes, the signal never repaints.Core Engine 03 // Leading Order-Flow Edge 100% Non-Repainting The Early In & Out Pro Indicator (MP_EarlyInNOut™) Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView Designed to give you a market-defying institutional edge, this leading telemetry tool is calibrated directly to our three power levels. First, it anticipates when smart-money accumulation is about to fire a compression early. Second, it flags buyer or seller exhaustion at the extreme of the move so you lock in gains before the reversal. The Trader Advantage: The exact exhaustion and distribution signal behind our live +600% overnight gain on Occidental Petroleum (OXY) Put Options.Core Engine 04 // Quantitative Expectancy 100% Non-Repainting On-Chart Historical Move & Duration Stats Tool Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView Puts real historical performance data directly at the top of your chart, calculating the average dollar/percentage gain, average bar duration, and historical long vs. short firing outcomes for every compression level on whatever symbol and timeframe you are viewing. The Trader Advantage: Options traders love this tool: knowing the average move size and duration tells you the exact strike (Delta) and expiration (DTE) to choose.Exclusive Bonus 01 // Real-Market Proof Included Bonus Quick-Start Setup Session + 5 Recorded Live-Trading Days On-Demand HD Video Archive + Workspace Templates Get up to speed in minutes with our step-by-step installation and chart configuration session, then watch 5 full recorded live-trading days showing how we execute the indicator suite in real market conditions across opening-bell scalps and multi-day swings. The Trader Advantage: Watch real-time trade selection, contract sizing, and stop management in live markets rather than cherry-picked hindsight slides.Exclusive Bonus 02 // Pinpoint Execution Class Included Bonus Special Bonus: The Precision Entries Recorded Masterclass Proposed HD Lessons + PDF Checklist Master the art of sniper entries and asymmetric 3R-to-5R risk structuring for stocks, ETFs, SPX index options, and $500+ small accounts. Learn how to combine our three indicator levels with Options Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, and Vega) so you never overpay for implied volatility. The Trader Advantage: Includes our downloadable Pre-Trade Execution Checklist covering exact entries, tiered profit exits, and hard stops. No Trader Left Behind • Universal Adaptability Who Is The Move Prior to The Move™ Pro System Built For? I know the pain of getting chopped up by volatile, "go-nowhere" price action and fake repainted arrows, because I stood on the losing end myself in the past. Once I stopped chasing late retail breakouts and was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading", everything changed. Instead of waiting for lagging retail oscillators, this system is engineered to give you an earlier institutional "heads up" that an explosive move is forming, allowing you to get in on the most powerful moves earlier, lock in gains sooner, and avoid midday chop. It is the exact telemetry behind our live calls on the 2020 COVID Top and Bottom, the 2022 Market Top and Bottom, and our +600% overnight gain on OXY Put Options live opposite Warren Buffett. With The Move Prior to The Move™ Pro System, You Can: ✓ Target big, high-velocity institutional moves and never chase an extended retail candle again✓ Instantly spot multi-level compression and order-flow absorption on ANY chart or timeframe✓ Know the historical "average" profit target and bar duration on ANY ticker at a glance✓ Protect your capital with pre-defined structural invalidation stops before risking a dollar Get Instant Access to the System ↓ Inspect All 6 Included Tools & Bonuses LIVE TELEMETRY PREVIEW ThinkorSwim & TradingView 1. 3 Power Levels 2. Early In/Out 3. Stats Tool 3 DYNAMIC COMPRESSION LEVELS: LOW [○] • HIGH [◐] • ULTRA [●]▲ OBJECTIVE BUY SIGNAL + STOPHARD INVALIDATION STOP-LOSS LEVEL (PLOTTED AUTOMATICALLY) Complete System Inventory What’s Included: ■ The Move Prior to The Move™ Core Indicator (3 Dynamic Compression Levels)■ Objective Buy/Sell & Structural Invalidation Signals■ MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro Leading Accumulation & Exhaustion Telemetry■ On-Chart Historical Expectancy & Move Stats Tool■ 5 Recorded Live-Market Trading Sessions (Real-Time Execution)■ Step-by-Step Quick-Start & Mobile App Installation Guide■ Complete System Strategy Class (On-Demand HD)■ Special Bonus: Precision Options & Equity Entries Masterclass Explore the Proposed Indicator Suite ↓ Complete Institutional Toolkit • Desktop & Mobile When You Sign Up, You Get These 6 Core Indicators, Tools & Exclusive Bonuses We don’t sell you a bare script and leave you guessing how to trade it. The proposed package includes the complete 4-part indicator engine plus 2 recorded live-market training bonuses: Core Engine 01 // Desktop & ThinkorSwim Mobile Ready 100% Non-Repainting The Move Prior to The Move™ Core Indicator (3 Signals in 1) Proposed for ThinkorSwim (Desktop + Mobile App) & TradingView Our flagship breakthrough combines three distinct institutional compression and absorption thresholds (Low, High, and Ultra) into a single non-repainting indicator. It dynamically adapts to faster, slower, and volatile price action, giving you an earlier "heads up" before an explosive directional move fires long or short. The Trader Advantage: Catches high-velocity moves that standard lagging oscillators miss while keeping you out of flat, "go-nowhere" midday chop.Core Engine 02 // Rule-Based Execution 100% Non-Repainting Calibrated Buy/Sell Entry & Invalidation Signals Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView • 100% Non-Repainting Engineered to eliminate hesitation at the moment of execution, these objective entry triggers are specifically calibrated to each of the three compression power levels. Higher-timeframe institutional trend direction and volume structure are automatically factored in. The Trader Advantage: Plots both the exact directional trigger bar and the structural invalidation stop-loss level. Once the candle closes, the signal never repaints.Core Engine 03 // Leading Order-Flow Edge 100% Non-Repainting The Early In & Out Pro Indicator (MP_EarlyInNOut™) Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView Designed to give you a market-defying institutional edge, this leading telemetry tool is calibrated directly to our three power levels. First, it anticipates when smart-money accumulation is about to fire a compression early. Second, it flags buyer or seller exhaustion at the extreme of the move so you lock in gains before the reversal. The Trader Advantage: The exact exhaustion and distribution signal behind our live +600% overnight gain on Occidental Petroleum (OXY) Put Options.Core Engine 04 // Quantitative Expectancy 100% Non-Repainting On-Chart Historical Move & Duration Stats Tool Proposed for ThinkorSwim & TradingView Puts real historical performance data directly at the top of your chart, calculating the average dollar/percentage gain, average bar duration, and historical long vs. short firing outcomes for every compression level on whatever symbol and timeframe you are viewing. The Trader Advantage: Options traders love this tool: knowing the average move size and duration tells you the exact strike (Delta) and expiration (DTE) to choose.Exclusive Bonus 01 // Real-Market Proof Included Bonus Quick-Start Setup Session + 5 Recorded Live-Trading Days On-Demand HD Video Archive + Workspace Templates Get up to speed in minutes with our step-by-step installation and chart configuration session, then watch 5 full recorded live-trading days showing how we execute the indicator suite in real market conditions across opening-bell scalps and multi-day swings. The Trader Advantage: Watch real-time trade selection, contract sizing, and stop management in live markets rather than cherry-picked hindsight slides.Exclusive Bonus 02 // Pinpoint Execution Class Included Bonus Special Bonus: The Precision Entries Recorded Masterclass Proposed HD Lessons + PDF Checklist Master the art of sniper entries and asymmetric 3R-to-5R risk structuring for stocks, ETFs, SPX index options, and $500+ small accounts. Learn how to combine our three indicator levels with Options Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, and Vega) so you never overpay for implied volatility. The Trader Advantage: Includes our downloadable Pre-Trade Execution Checklist covering exact entries, tiered profit exits, and hard stops. No Trader Left Behind • Universal Adaptability Who Is The Move Prior to The Move™ Pro System Built For? Because our indicator suite automatically calibrates to volatility and timeframe structure, it adapts directly to your account size, preferred asset class, and daily schedule: Pillar 01 // Account Most trading education companies exist for one reason: to extract money from hopeful traders by selling overpriced courses and fake, repainted "holy grail" indicators that fail the moment real volatility hits. I hate what this industry does to everyday people because I have been on the losing end myself in the past. Everything changed when I was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called me "the future of trading." The Pain of the Retail Trap: Why I Refuse to Sell Hype Nobody starts trading expecting to be lied to. Early in my journey, I experienced the exact pain that millions of retail traders in the US and Canada go through every single day. I saw how the retail trading industry operates behind the curtain: flashy marketers selling overpriced courses filled with basic textbook theory and peddling repainted "magic arrow" indicators that look perfect in hindsight screenshots but bleed your account dry in live market chop. Standing on the losing end taught me a lesson I never forgot: retail traders don’t fail because they lack work ethic; they fail because they are fed retail garbage designed to make educators rich while keeping traders trapped as exit liquidity for Wall Street. 2. The Goldman Sachs Mentorship: Learning From Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick The breakthrough that changed my life forever didn't come from a retail chatroom; it came from the highest level of institutional proprietary trading. I was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, widely known on Wall Street as one of the most profitable proprietary traders in Goldman Sachs history before founding Mount Kellett Capital. Mark didn't teach lagging retail oscillators or meme-stock gambling. He taught me how institutional balance sheets actually move price: how smart money accumulates at capitulation bottoms, how institutions engineer liquidity sweeps at market tops to trap retail buyers, and how to structure asymmetric risk using options. Watching how I synthesized his institutional playbook with modern technical execution, Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick called me "the future of trading." 3. Bringing Wall Street’s Playbook to Main Street Wall Street hates when everyday traders learn how the game is actually rigged. Instead of locking that institutional edge behind a hedge fund door, or charging extortionate fees like fake internet gurus, I founded Revolution Trading Pros to put that exact weapon into the hands of working professionals, full-time day traders, and small-account traders starting with as little as $500. What We Reject The Predatory "Fake Guru" Model Overpriced "Holy Grail" Indicators: Selling lagging, repainted scripts for exorbitant fees that fail in live volatility. Zero Institutional Pedigree: Self-proclaimed "experts" who have never been trained by an institutional prop trader or called a major macro turn. Profiting Off Losses: Making millions from subscription churn while members blow up their brokerage accounts. Ignoring Small Accounts & Working Pros: Teaching reckless sizing that destroys $500 accounts and impossible schedules for 9-to-5 workers. What We Built The Revolution Trading Pros Standard Goldman Sachs Mentored Edge: Direct lineage from Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, built on real institutional order flow and liquidity mechanics. People Over Profits: Kept intentionally affordable so your capital stays in your trading account where it belongs. Exact Entries, Exits & Stops Ahead of Time: Every live trade and video watchlist maps out clear trigger levels, targets, and hard stops before price moves. Application-Only 1-on-1 Mentorship: You cannot simply buy 1-on-1 coaching; we approve only committed, coachable traders. Hard Evidence • Recorded Live in Front of Traders Built on Institutional Execution & Risk-First Transparency Anyone can post a winning screenshot in a bull market. Institutional discipline is demonstrated at major macro turning points and by managing defined-risk options structures around real-time liquidity exhaustion (past performance is not indicative of future results). Pillar 01 // Wall Street Institutional Lineage Goldman Sachs Prop Mentorship Mentored Directly by Former Goldman Sachs Legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick The Market Setup & Retail Trap: Retail trading education fails because it is taught by marketers who have never sat near an institutional desk or managed real order flow. Our Real-Time Institutional Execution: Trained directly under Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, one of the highest-earning proprietary traders in Goldman Sachs history, who explicitly called our founder "the future of trading." Core Mechanics: Institutional Order Flow • Smart-Money Liquidity Traps • Asymmetric Risk StructuringPillar 02 // Live Single-Stock Options Execution +600% Overnight on OXY Puts Contrarian Defined-Risk OXY Put Options Execution During Institutional Distribution The Market Setup & Retail Trap: When mainstream financial media celebrated Warren Buffett buying millions of dollars of OXY stock on the long side, retail traders blindly chased the headline at the top of the liquidity sweep. Our Real-Time Institutional Execution: Reading institutional distribution and buyer exhaustion in real time, we stepped in on the opposite side live with defined-risk OXY Put Options and locked in a 600% overnight gain. Core Mechanics: Liquidity Sweep Recognition • Institutional Distribution Tape • Defined-Risk Put OptionsPillar 03 // 2020 Macro Inflection Timing 2020 Top & Bottom Called Live Called the Exact 2020 COVID Crash Top and Generational Market Bottom The Market Setup & Retail Trap: Before the February–March 2020 liquidation cascaded across global indexes, retail gurus told traders to buy every dip on the way down and then panicked into cash at the March bottom. Our Real-Time Institutional Execution: We warned traders of the structural breakdown at the 2020 top before the crash accelerated, and then pivoted at the exact March 2020 capitulation low to capture the generational recovery. Core Mechanics: Volatility Regime Expansion • Capitulation Volume Exhaustion • Macro Cycle InflectionPillar 04 // 2022 Macro Inflection Timing 2022 Top & Bottom Called Live Repeated the Feat: Called the 2022 Bull Market Top and Bear Market Bottom The Market Setup & Retail Trap: Calling one macro cycle could be dismissed by skeptics as luck. Repeating it in the very next cycle proves a repeatable, institutional methodology. Our Real-Time Institutional Execution: Called the macro distribution top at the start of 2022 before growth and index equities plunged, and identified the October 2022 institutional accumulation bottom while Wall Street pundits predicted another crash. Core Mechanics: Multi-Cycle Repeatability • Institutional Accumulation Zones • Breadth & Liquidity Divergence No Trader Left Behind • Built Around Your Real Life How We Serve Working Professionals, Day Traders, and Small Accounts Starting at $500 Because our mission is helping people achieve their dreams rather than chasing high-ticket fees, we engineered our rooms and alert services so every trader has a clear, realistic path forward, regardless of schedule or starting capital. 01 // Busy 9-to-5 Careers Working Professionals You don’t need to quit your job or stare at 1-minute charts for six hours a day to trade like an institution. Through our Swing Trading Room and our Sunday Alpha Protocol video watchlists, you receive complete trade plans with exact targeted entries, profit exits, and hard stop-losses you can set and manage around your workday.
